title: Tor amplitude modulo a nilpotent ideal agrees with tor amplitude over the ring
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the tor amplitude of a complex over a ring with that of its reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal, and the proof is a 32-line argument by induction on the nilpotency index. One direction is immediate from the general behaviour of tor amplitude under base change; for the other, the module against which the derived tensor product is formed is filtered by the submodules I^t M', and the induction runs on the length of this filtration, using the distinguished triangle attached to the short exact sequence at each step. The filtration and the triangle argument are carried out in full.
